row 59 | cb2026.d021826b = 
row 60 | cb2026.d021826b = 
row 61 | cb2026.d021826b = Data source: U.S. Energy Information Administration (EIA), Short-Term Energy Outlook, November 2025, and EIA, Annual Energy Outlook 2026
row 62 | cb2026.d021826b = (AEO2026) National Energy Modeling System (NEMS) run cb2026.d021826b. Projections: EIA, AEO2026 NEMS run cb2026.d021826b.
row 63 | cb2026.d021826b = Note: By convention, the direct emissions from biogenic energy sources are excluded from energy-related carbon dioxide emissions. The release 
row 64 | cb2026.d021826b = of carbon from these sources is assumed to be balanced by the uptake of carbon when the feedstock is grown, resulting in zero net
row 65 | cb2026.d021826b = emissions over some period of time. If, however, increased use of biomass energy results in a decline in terrestrial 
row 66 | cb2026.d021826b = carbon stocks, a net positive release of carbon may occur. See Table 71. Energy-Related Carbon Dioxide Emissions by End Use, for the
row 67 | cb2026.d021826b = emissions from biogenic energy sources as an indication of the potential net release of carbon dioxide in the absence of offsetting
row 68 | cb2026.d021826b = sequestration. Totals may not equal sum of components due to independent rounding. 
row 69 | cb2026.d021826b = 1/ Emissions from the electric power sector are distributed to the end-use sectors based on their share of total electricity consumption.
row 70 | cb2026.d021826b = 2/ Includes combined-heat-and-power plants that have a non-regulatory status and small on-site generating systems.
row 71 | cb2026.d021826b = 3/ Includes lease and plant fuel.
row 72 | cb2026.d021826b = 4/ Includes vented emissions from natural gas processing.
row 73 | cb2026.d021826b = 5/ Does not include industrial process emissions, which are not energy-related.
